description: Eliminate window jitter by hiding new windows offscreen immediately in the AX observer callback, before any async work begins

userStories.title: Create synchronous window discovery helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to synchronously get all windows from an app's AXUIElement so I can identify newly created windows in the observer callback.
acceptanceCriteria: Create function `getWindowIdsSync(from appElement: AXUIElement) -> [UInt32]` in Sources/AppBundle/util/accessibility.swift
Uses `AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue` to get `kAXWindowsAttribute`
Uses `_AXUIElementGetWindow` (from PrivateApi) to get window ID for each window element
Function is synchronous (no async/await)
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
userStories.notes: Check existing Ax class in accessibility.swift for patterns

userStories.title: Track known window IDs per app
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to track which windows we've already seen so I can identify new ones when a creation notification arrives.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `knownWindowIds: Set<UInt32>` property to `MacApp` class in Sources/AppBundle/tree/MacApp.swift
Update the set when windows are registered in `MacWindow.getOrRegister`
Update the set when windows are garbage collected in `MacWindow.garbageCollect`
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
userStories.notes: Consider thread safety - observer runs on per-app thread

userStories.title: Hide new window immediately in observer callback
userStories.description: As a user, I want new windows to be hidden before I can see them at their default macOS position.
acceptanceCriteria: In `refreshObs` (Sources/AppBundle/layout/refresh.swift), when `kAXWindowCreatedNotification` is received, query app's current windows using `getWindowIdsSync`
Compare with `knownWindowIds` to find new window ID(s)
For each new window, set position offscreen using synchronous `AXUIElementSetAttributeValue` with `kAXPositionAttribute`
This happens BEFORE the `Task { @MainActor in ... }` dispatch
Hide to bottom-right corner: position = (screenWidth + 100, screenHeight + 100)
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
userStories.notes: The `ax` parameter in refreshObs is the app's AXUIElement. Use NSScreen.main for screen dimensions.

userStories.title: Verify layout correctly positions hidden windows
userStories.description: As a user, I want hidden windows to appear at their correct tiled position after layout runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Normal `layoutWorkspaces()` flow positions windows correctly (no changes needed)
Windows that were hidden offscreen now appear at their tiled position
Manually test: open new tiling window (e.g., kitty), confirm no jitter and correct final position
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
userStories.notes: This is mostly verification - existing layout code should handle it

userStories.title: Skip hiding for popup and dialog windows
userStories.description: As a user, I want popup and dialog windows to appear at their natural macOS position.
acceptanceCriteria: Before hiding, check window's `kAXSubroleAttribute` synchronously
Skip hiding for subroles: AXDialog, AXFloatingWindow, AXSystemFloatingWindow, AXSheet
If subrole check fails or is nil, hide anyway (safer default)
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
